factory_info.layout_description: A parallel production line laid out along the sequence Machining -> Quality Inspection -> Cutting -> Packaging -> Assembly -> Palletizing, with stations grouped by workflow step.

parallel_groups.reasoning: Steps Cutting, Quality Inspection do not share equipment or line dependencies, so they can run concurrently without blocking one another.
